title: ChannelTrafficShapingHandler causes a NullPointerException in Netty 4.0.0 RC1
body:
ChannelTrafficShapingHandler causes an exception when a pipeline is created on the client-side.
Example pipeline:

```
ChannelTrafficShapingHandler channelTrafficShaper = new ChannelTrafficShapingHandler(10000);
p.addLast("shaper", channelTrafficShaper);
p.addLast("encoder", new ObjectEncoder());
p.addLast("decoder", new ObjectDecoder(ClassResolvers.softCachingConcurrentResolver(null)));
p.addLast("handler1", new ChannelInboundMessageHandlerAdapter<String>() {
    @Override
    public void messageReceived(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, String msg) throws Exception {
        // ...........
    }
});
```

Cause:
The exception occurs because "ctx" is null at "if (ctx.hasInboundByteBuffer())"

```
class DefaultChannelHandlerContext {

    @Override
    public ByteBuf nextInboundByteBuffer() {
        DefaultChannelHandlerContext ctx = next;
        for (;;) {
            if (ctx.hasInboundByteBuffer()) {
                Thread currentThread = Thread.currentThread();
                if (ctx.executor().inEventLoop(currentThread)) {
```
